critique.evidence: The before/after ledger, repeated 25.60× result, ROI formula, and “Review the adaptive arena” CTA make the metric and next destination visible. However, the central claim is internally contradictory: the copy says the defense “wins the campaign,” while the result is explicitly “ABOVE BREAK-EVEN” at a still-profitable 25.60× attacker ROI. On tablet, the fixed navigation also overlays the headline and supporting sentence, materially impairing first-read comprehension.
critique.fix: Make the conclusion match the evidence: state that defense reduced attacker ROI from 545.35× to 25.60× but has not yet made attacks uneconomic, then frame the arena CTA as the next step to drive ROI below 0×. Fix the tablet header so it does not cover the hero copy.
